column2: #1. Questions: How does the time spent outdoors on work/school days differ across education levels among adutls ages 29-59?
#This can be done by comparing outdoor_workday across the 4 education levels: less than highschool, high school or GED, some college or AA, and college graduate or above.

#2. Description: The variables we're looking at are outdoor_workday (minutes spent outdoors from 9am to 5pm) and education. We compare the means in outdoor time across these groups. The linear model is then used to estiamte differences in the means of outdoor time, using less than high school as the reference group.

#3. Main Analysis: Histograms are used to compare the outdoor time spent across 4 education levels. Then, the linear model will calculate the 90% condifence interval for the difference in the mean of outdoor time across 4 groups.
